question: "The biriyani tastes as good as it looks." into comparative degree of adjectives. [ORG-26]
options: The biriyani looks better than it tastes
The biriyani tastes better than it looks
The biriyani both tastes and looks better
The biriyani tastes no better than it looks
explanation: সঠিক Comparative form-টি হবে। The biriyani tastes better than it looks. Comparative structure-টি হলো Subject + V + Comparative Adjective + than + others.

question: My mother is the —— inspiration in most my life. [BCIC-25]
explanation: এখানে Adjective এর Superlative form হবে; কারণ Superlative degree এর পূর্বে The বসে। আর big এর Superlative form হলো biggest.

question: The roads of Dhaka are wider — [SGCL-2023]
explanation: উক্ত Sentence-টি Comparative degree-এর অন্তর্গত। Comparative degree-তে than এর পর The roads of-এর পরিবর্তে those ব্যবহার করা হয়। সুতরাং, than those of Barishal বসবে।

question: Identify the correct comparative form of the sentence : They are the wisest of all. [BSCIC-2023]
options: They are more wiser than others.
They are more wise from others.
They are wiser than all others.
explanation: Comparative structure-টি হলো Sub + to be + Comp. form + than + —. structure অনুযায়ী সঠিক বাক্যটি হলো "They are wiser than all others."

question: Which one is superlative degree? [R&H-2006, MOD-20]
explanation: Bad-এর Comparative form worse এবং Superlative worst, যার অর্থ খুব নিকৃষ্ট।

question: Dhaka is becoming one of the —— cities in Asia. [BWDB-2020]
explanation: বাক্যে One of the থাকলে Superlative degree বসে। শূন্যস্থানে busiest বসবে।

question: Which is — of the two? [HED-2019]
explanation: Than ব্যবহার না করেও দুইটি জিনিসের মাঝে তুলনা করা যায়। সুতরাং এক্ষেত্রে the + comparative + of the two ব্যবহৃত হয়।

question: The roads of Dhaka are wider– [MOLE-2019; MOCA-2019]
explanation: দুটি বস্তুর মধ্যে তুলনা করার সময় একই Noun হলে পূর্ববর্তী Noun-এর পুনরাবৃত্তি দূর করতে Plural noun-এর স্থলে those বসে।

question: Of the two boys, Latif is — intelligent. [MOLE-2019]
explanation: দুইজনের মধ্যে তুলনা করলে Comparative degree হবে। More Comparative degree।

question: Of the two girls, Supriti is — intelligent. [HED-2019]
explanation: দুইয়ের মধ্যে তুলনা বুঝাতে comparative হয়। সুতরাং সঠিক উত্তর more !

question: The greater the demand — the price. [TTC-2018]
explanation: যত ........... তত বুঝাতে Comparative হয়। তাই, the higher বসবে যেহেতু the greater বসেছে।

question: What is the superlative degree of 'bad'? [WASA, MOR-2018]
explanation: Bad (খারাপ) শব্দটির Comparative হলো Worse ও Superlative form Worst।

question: I prepare my lesson – than you. [MODMR-2006]
explanation: এখানে Comparative degree হবে, কারণ ---- + than you আছে। তাই more carefully হবে।

question: Sumon was one–. [MOE-2004]
options: of the happiest children in the class
of the happy children in the class
of the happiest child in the class
of the happy childs in the class
explanation: Happy-এর Superlative form Happiest. Superlative degree-এর পূর্বে the বসে।
